questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road. Watch for people in the crosswalk and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for bicycles crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: Start slowing down when you see this sign. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the road will soon split into separate directions for each direction of traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane will leave the freeway. You must exit if you stay in this lane, or you can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be present on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for red lights and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign marks objects or areas that may be dangerous. You should avoid them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to watch for buggies on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a playground is nearby. Watch for children near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This creates a serious risk of head-on collision. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers can use it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the shoulder ahead is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: The right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle. You should slow down for this sharp curve just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder ahead is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means you may use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be prepared to allow the merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead has a series of curves and turns.
